name: luxurious-red-lips-heart-bagel
image_purpose: food campaign and luxury product editorial

prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic 4:5 luxury food editorial portrait of one original approved adult woman presenting heart-shaped pastries on a gold tray against a rich deep-red background.
prompt.main_subject: Original approved adult woman with an elegant updo, warm smile, bold glossy red lipstick, red manicure, pearl earrings, and natural skin texture. She wears a black satin halter-neck dress and holds a gold serving tray with a dome lid lifted to reveal three heart-shaped bagels or pastries topped with glossy red cream and edible gold accents.
composition_elements: Slightly low editorial product angle with tray and pastries in sharp foreground focus and the woman behind it.
Rich deep-red gradient background, polished gold tray, reflective dome lid, and clear pastry texture.
Preserve hand anatomy, red manicure, tray reveal, pastry shapes, and luxury patisserie presentation.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: High-end softbox key light with controlled glossy highlights on the dome and cream, gentle fill on the face, and soft shadows against the red background.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 4:5 portrait product scene, 50mm lens at f/4, shallow depth of field focused on tray and pastries, realistic pastry crumb, cream gloss, metal reflections, visible skin texture, subtle grain, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Luxury food editorial portrait of one original approved adult woman with an elegant updo, warm smile, bold glossy red lipstick, red manicure, pearl earrings and natural skin texture. She wears a black satin halter-neck dress and holds a polished gold serving tray in the foreground while lifting its dome lid to reveal three heart-shaped bagels or pastries topped with glossy red cream and edible gold accents. Use a rich deep-red gradient background, a slightly low 50mm product angle, sharp focus on the tray and pastries, soft high-end studio lighting, realistic pastry texture and metal reflections, 4:5 composition, no text or watermark.
